articles.summary: PGE customers who live in areas at risk of wildfires have experienced more than a 60% reduction in power outages from 2021 to 2025 due to system hardening efforts.
articles.title: Walk the line: PGE vegetation work helps reduce outages by 60%

articles.summary: Measuring vegetation moisture is helping PGE better understand fire potential in high-risk areas and refine efforts to keep customers and communities safe.
articles.title: PGE leads Pacific Northwest with first-of-its-kind wildfire research
